Chose 30,000 reads for even sampling depth, ensures i am retaining as many samples as possible without losing rare taxa as much as possible.


```{bash}
source /opt/anaconda/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate qiime2-2026.7
cd ~/Dailey-546

# Define paths
TABLE="output/week3/03.2-metabarcoding-workflow/16s-table.qza"
SEQS="output/week3/03.2-metabarcoding-workflow/16s-rep-seqs.qza"
METADATA="data/metadata2.tsv"  # Replace with your metadata path
OUT="output/project"


qiime fragment-insertion sepp \
  --i-representative-sequences "$SEQS" \
  --i-reference-database data/sepp-refs-silva-128.qza \
  --p-threads 16 \
  --o-tree "$OUT/insertion-tree.qza" \
  --o-placements "$OUT/insertion-placements.qza"


qiime fragment-insertion filter-features \
  --i-table "$TABLE" \
  --i-tree "$OUT/insertion-tree.qza" \
  --o-filtered-table "$OUT/table-in-tree.qza" \
  --o-removed-table "$OUT/table-not-in-tree.qza"


qiime diversity core-metrics-phylogenetic \
  --i-table "$OUT/table-in-tree.qza" \
  --i-phylogeny "$OUT/insertion-tree.qza" \
  --m-metadata-file "$METADATA" \
  --p-sampling-depth 30000 \
  --output-dir "$OUT/core-metrics-30k"


qiime metadata tabulate \
  --m-input-file "$OUT/core-metrics-30k/observed_features_vector.qza" \
  --m-input-file "$OUT/core-metrics-30k/shannon_vector.qza" \
  --m-input-file "$OUT/core-metrics-30k/evenness_vector.qza" \
  --m-input-file "$OUT/core-metrics-30k/faith_pd_vector.qza" \
  --o-visualization "$OUT/alpha-diversity-core-30k.qzv"


qiime diversity alpha-group-significance \
  --i-alpha-diversity "$OUT/core-metrics-30k/observed_features_vector.qza" \
  --m-metadata-file "$METADATA" \
  --o-visualization "$OUT/core-metrics-30k/observed-asvs-groups.qzv"

qiime diversity alpha-group-significance \
  --i-alpha-diversity "$OUT/core-metrics-30k/shannon_vector.qza" \
  --m-metadata-file "$METADATA" \
  --o-visualization "$OUT/core-metrics-30k/shannon-groups.qzv"

qiime diversity alpha-group-significance \
  --i-alpha-diversity "$OUT/core-metrics-30k/evenness_vector.qza" \
  --m-metadata-file "$METADATA" \
  --o-visualization "$OUT/core-metrics-30k/evenness-groups.qzv"

qiime diversity alpha-group-significance \
  --i-alpha-diversity "$OUT/core-metrics-30k/faith_pd_vector.qza" \
  --m-metadata-file "$METADATA" \
  --o-visualization "$OUT/core-metrics-30k/faith-pd-groups.qzv"
```
